issues.description: The verification patch moves the executable MetaSlot type ahead of the mapping module instead of preserving the source item order.
issues.rationale: In the base, the mapping module is the first item in the Verus block and `MetaSlot` remains in its established location after the imports and constants. The selected final head moves the entire executable `MetaSlot` definition to immediately after the mapping module, solely alongside the new layout proof machinery. Review comment 3465862439 explicitly identifies the original order and asks that the definition not be moved; GitHub still maps that comment to the selected final head, and the exported source confirms the move remains. The later official `preserve-exec-code` guideline codifies the same maintainability requirement: proof migration must not move executable items or alter import-independent item order merely to make verification compile. That guideline postdates this review and is used only to adjudicate the concrete source-order request, not to invent a new issue. The later LGTM does not explicitly retract the still-unresolved, final-head-mapped request.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus not executed. Read the complete archived discussion and current remote PR metadata, commits, review threads including replies, reviews, and issue comments; confirmed the comment remains mapped to the selected final head; compared the exported before/after source; mechanically verified the base/head relationship with GitHub compare; and checked the later official guideline used for adjudication.
